card.name: Words after 'to be' or 'used'
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'useful', 'used' or 'issued' right after 'to be' or a similar verb, and sometimes partway through long medical words such as hypothermia, diuresis or methemoglobinemia.

modes.label: Use/issue verbs
modes.description: Forms of 'use' or 'issue', or 'obtain', in passive or infinitive phrases.
modes.example: The residual uranium is reprocessed to be<< used>> in new fuel rods.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of long words in overdose-treatment passages.

card.writes: Weakly suppresses words about handling and processing, so it pushes against 'handle/process' continuations.
